payload.body:
OpenERP becomes a Sentropic dev-app (managed lifecycle, like radar-immobilier) running as a pure OIDC Relying Party against the Sentropic IdP (@sentropic/auth-hono).

User decisions taken:
- Stateful DB-backed sessions (option 1B)
- Tenant model follows Sentropic (workspace at OauthClient level; tenantId is NOT a JWT claim)
- rpID/passkey ceremonies live at the Sentropic IdP (auth.sent-tech.ca); OpenERP runs no WebAuthn server
- OpenERP retains its own internal multi-tenancy (organizations + organization_members + organization_id session claim)

Scope of AUTH-39-A (subset of auth-hono, ~8 of 15 ports):
- DELETE passkey-service.ts, webauthn.ts handler, identity-provider.ts issuer parts
- ADD oidc-client.ts, openerp_session_port, openerp_user_port, cookie/token/account-policy ports
- ADD migration 0034 openerp_sessions (with organization_id extension) + 0035 oidc_state (PKCE/nonce)
- ADD handlers /auth/login, /auth/oauth/callback, /auth/logout, /auth/org-select
- Env: add OAUTH_ISSUER_URL/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET/REDIRECT_URI; retire OPENERP_WEBAUTHN_* + OPENERP_WEB_ORIGIN
- jose downgrade ^6 -> ^5 (auth-hono peer dep)
- Org-picker: JSON 409 {code:ORGANIZATION_SELECTION_REQUIRED, organizations:[]}
- Hard guards: publicKey base64url decode, createRemoteJWKSet caching, state/nonce binding, PKCE S256

Awaiting:
- Opus peer-review (aadc37b621e0635e8) — adversarial fact-check of the plan
- Sentropic-team residual: tenantId on the openerp OauthClient row (set vs null)
- Sentropic-team action: register openerp OauthClient + k8s namespace + KUBE_CONFIG_DATA
payload.title: AUTH-39-A: adopt @sentropic/auth-hono as OIDC RP (Sentropic dev-app lifecycle)

payload.body: Originally: OpenERP standalone IdP via @sentropic/auth-hono OAuth routes + JWKS. With user decision that OpenERP becomes Sentropic dev-app (always RP), this slice may be downscoped/dropped. Re-evaluate after AUTH-39-A.
payload.title: AUTH-39-B: OAuth/OIDC IdP standalone (may be obsoleted by RP-only model)

payload.body: OpenERP as OIDC RP fully embedded in openerp.sent-tech.ca; @sentropic/auth-client for service-to-service calls (DPoP optional). Likely merges into AUTH-39-A scope given the dev-app decision.
payload.title: AUTH-39-C: embedded mode + S2S via @sentropic/auth-client

payload.body: Switch session JWTs from HS256 to EdDSA. Migrate /auth/exchange-agent-token to client_credentials. Multi-kid JWKS rotation window. Admin user bootstrap policy.
payload.title: AUTH-39-D: hardening (EdDSA sessions, RFC8693 migration, key rotation, admin bootstrap)

payload.body: Once AUTH-39-A lands: flip OPENERP_CHAT_ENABLED default ON, wire the Bearer from openerp_sessions through /chat-transport. e2e proves the chat panel renders with a valid agent context.
